lists.name: RYM Top — Pop — Stomp and Holler

podcast.title: USS European Tour (2012)
podcast.body: USS toured Europe for the first time in 2012, opening for Walk Off the Earth. "So in 2012, Ash and I had just returned from touring Europe for the first time, opening for Walk Off the Earth."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: USS In Their Own Words: Part 2

podcast.title: Softer Alt Rock Trend (2010s)
podcast.body: This band is listed as one of the acts that fit into the trend of softer sounding and poppier alt rock that emerged in the 2010s, a style influenced by Mumford & Sons. "Of monsters and men, kaleo, George Ezra, Vance Joy, Hosea, Congo's, walk off the earth and walk the moon."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 2: The Role of Indie Rock

podcast.title: Tokyo Spears as Drummer
podcast.body: The drummer Tokyo Spears, formerly of The Cardboard Crowns, is now playing with Walk Off the Earth. "And the drummer is he's now with walk off the earth actually he's now playing his name is Tokyo spears."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: USS In Their Own Words: Part 2

podcast.title: YouTube Breakout with One Guitar Cover
podcast.body: Walk Off The Earth achieved their "big break" after posting a YouTube video featuring five members playing a single guitar to cover Gotye's "Somebody That I Used To Know." This video garnered 21 million views, propelling them to online fame. "Walk The Earth and their big break after they posted a YouTube video of five members playing this song on guitar? 21 million views later."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 4: (70-61)
